### Prerequisites:
- A usable remote control and a normal display screen
- The device is already in shipping status (AI has been authorized and the algorithm has been imported)
- The device firmware is a customized version that supports passenger flow statistics
- The computer has the PC-Client tool installed and can ping the AI camera in the same LAN

### Operation steps:
1. Press the middle "ENTER" confirmation button on the remote control to enter the login interface and enter the default administrator password "999999"
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e28d2a36007aa4bd6f01ba5d107fa186)

2. Press the ENTER button on the remote control to enter [Settings]---[Serial]---[Serial]. Press the ENTER button again to enter the editing state, move to the bottom to select the serial port index, serial port function and baud rate, and confirm to save.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=dfb4bf41b96f7d93db158a6f7edc5d5f)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b440d9335d6a8514835877517a4db65d)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=abbf373ffa3f79b7fca460ee0f1470fb)

3. Use a network cable to directly connect the computer and the camera to ping, or in the same LAN, run the PC-Client tool to search for the connected camera. The default IPIP of the general camera is: 192.168.1.253. Set the AI ​​camera parameters and restart the device and AI camera after completion.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=1f480eb6ae0f8e32acc9f1fea7f5fed2)

4. After restarting, you can check the number of passengers and the door opening and closing status in the lower right corner of the display
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a2b6eaaa80c5b5b5fe947b70b71f5ba9)
